content: This report is split into further five sections. In section SECREF2, we describe the contextual embeddings ELMo. In Section SECREF3, we describe the datasets used and in Section SECREF4 we describe preprocessing and training of the embeddings. We describe the methodology for evaluation of created vectors and results in Section SECREF5. We present conclusion in Section SECREF6 where we also outline plans for further work.
